address: 1F, The St. Regis Osaka, 3-6-12 Hommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 541-0053, Japan
bio: Casual French dining in St. Regis Hotel Osaka, where prix fixe menus change with the seasons. Supervising the cuisine is the chef from Ryuzu in Tokyo. Classic techniques meet a simple, modern décor and a deep respect for French tradition is reflected in the emphasis on quality ingredients. The house features a spacious interior, mosaic floor and outdoor terrace—de rigueur for a brasserie....
